page.overview:
Who is Linnar, Sindri, and Uri?

Linnar, Sindri, and Uri were three non-canonical Dwarves of the Second Age, who each received one of the Dwarven Rings of Power.

They were created in the The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game and were each royal lords after they received their Rings. The mined for Mithril, as well as Gold and Silver. Their Rings eventually faded, but it is not known whether they were eaten by dragons or fell into the hands of Sauron.

Sindri, Uri, and Linnar were portrayed by Rich Mayberry, Gino Acevedo, and Xander Forterie.
